screening_decisions.reason: Review article about traumatic macular holes; not an RCT and does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap techniques.
Review article discussing retinal damage from ILM peeling; not an RCT and does not compare the interventions of interest.
Systematic review and meta-analysis, not an RCT. While it includes 4 RCTs in its analysis, this study itself is not a primary RCT.
Prospective observational case series, not an RCT. Does not compare ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap.
Retrospective study comparing phacovitrectomy vs vitrectomy alone, not ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap. Wrong intervention comparison.
Meta-analysis, not an RCT. Includes various study types but is not a primary randomized trial.
Classification/consensus document for SD-OCT imaging; not an RCT and not related to surgical interventions.
Retrospective analysis of medical records, not an RCT. Although it compares ILM peeling vs inverted flap, the study design is not randomized.
Retrospective longitudinal cohort study examining incidence and risk factors; not an RCT and does not compare surgical interventions.
Meta-analysis of RCTs, not an RCT itself. While it analyzes 5 RCTs, this study is a secondary analysis.
Systematic review with single-arm meta-analysis, not an RCT. Does not provide direct comparison data from a randomized trial.
Review article about cataract formation after vitrectomy; not an RCT and unrelated to macular hole surgical techniques.
Animal study (monkey model) investigating mechanism of MH closure; not an RCT in humans.
Population-based retrospective chart review; not an RCT and does not compare surgical interventions.
Methodological paper describing a risk of bias assessment tool; not an RCT and not related to macular hole treatment.
Literature review about ILM peeling techniques; not an RCT.

RCT comparing two variations of inverted ILM flap technique (classic vs modified without extra manipulation). Both arms use inverted ILM flap, not comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap as required by protocol.
Methodological paper about search strategies for RCTs; not an RCT and not related to macular hole treatment.
RCT comparing two variations of inverted ILM flap technique (temporal vs classic). Both arms use inverted ILM flap, not comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap as required by protocol.

Prospective randomized study comparing standard ILM peel (SIP) vs inverted ILM flap technique (IFT) for large macular holes (minimum linear dimension ≥600μm, which exceeds the >400μm criterion). Idiopathic MHs included. Meets all selection criteria: RCT design, correct intervention comparison, large MH population.
Observational comparative study, not an RCT. Compares epiretinal membrane vs macular hole patients rather than comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap techniques.
Review article summarizing natural history and pathogenesis of idiopathic FTMH. Not an RCT and does not compare surgical techniques.
Systematic review/meta-analysis comparing ILM peeling vs no peeling, not ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap. Wrong comparison per protocol.
RCT comparing vitrectomy vs observation alone, not comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap techniques.
Population-based epidemiological study about causes of visual impairment. Not related to macular hole surgery comparison.
Prospective randomized clinical trial comparing standard PPV (with ILM peeling) vs inverted ILM flap technique for macular holes >400µm. Meets all selection criteria.
Retrospective consecutive noncomparative case series about macular hole reopening. Not an RCT and does not compare surgical techniques.
Comparative study of inverted ILM flap vs complete ILM removal in myopic macular holes. Abstract does not explicitly state randomization was used. Conservative exclusion due to uncertain RCT status.
Theoretical paper proposing hydration theory for macular hole formation. Not a clinical trial or RCT.
RCT comparing platelet-rich plasma vs inverted ILM flap, not ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap. Wrong comparison per protocol.
Epidemiological prevalence study of idiopathic macular hole in South India. Not an RCT or surgical comparison.
Statistical methods paper about detecting skewness from summary data. Completely unrelated to macular hole surgery.
Editorial/commentary discussing ILM peeling controversies. Not an RCT or primary research study.
Expert consensus paper developing OCT-based classification system for vitreomacular diseases. Not an RCT or surgical comparison.
Prospective randomized interventional study comparing multilayered inverted ILM flap vs standard ILM peeling for large macular holes. Meets all selection criteria.
Observational study describing stages of idiopathic macular hole formation. Not an RCT or surgical comparison.
Retrospective chart review about bilaterality of idiopathic macular holes. Not an RCT or surgical comparison.
Comparative study of inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling for large MHs. Unequal group sizes (14 vs 10) and no mention of randomization suggests non-randomized design.
Comparative study of ILM removal vs temporal inverted flap technique. Abstract does not explicitly state randomization was used. Conservative exclusion due to uncertain RCT status.
Prospective randomized control trial comparing ILM peeling vs inverted ILM flap for large FTMH (600-1500µm). Meets all selection criteria.
Methodological paper on statistical measures for meta-analysis heterogeneity. Not related to macular hole surgery or RCT design.
Review article on epidemiology and general treatment outcomes. Not an RCT; does not compare specific surgical techniques.
Meta-analysis of RCTs, not a primary RCT. Selection criteria requires original randomized controlled trials only.
Pathogenesis/observational study on early stages of macular holes. No surgical intervention comparison; not an RCT.
RCT comparing two variants of inverted ILM flap (Cover vs Fill), not inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling. Average MH diameter was 397 µm (<400 µm threshold).
RCT comparing inverted ILM flap vs subretinal aspiration, not inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling. Wrong comparator arm.
Narrative review article discussing ILM peeling rationale and techniques. Not an RCT; no primary data.

Compares ILM flat covering (inverted ILM flap equivalent) vs ILM stripping (conventional peeling) for giant idiopathic and high myopia macular holes. Matches intervention and population. Study design unclear from abstract - conservative inclusion pending full-text verification.
RCT comparing extended vs standard ILM dissection, not inverted ILM flap vs conventional ILM peeling. Interventions do not match review question.
Epidemiological population study on epiretinal membranes prevalence. Not related to macular hole surgery; not an RCT.
